info.title: Splat API
info.description: JSON API for the Splat dashboard SPA plus the Sentry-compatible ingestion endpoints. Dashboard endpoints authenticate with the session cookie set by POST /api/v1/login (401 JSON when missing).

bearerAuth.description: API key secret (egt_...). Scopes: ingest (event ingestion), read (GET API), write (mutating API). A key bound to a project is confined to that project's ingestion and reads; instance routes (settings, rules, storage, key management) need the admin session or an unbound key, and key management needs the admin session.

mutedUntil.description: Mute expiry, or null when not muted / muted forever.

resolvedInRelease.description: Release pin for resolve-in-next-release, or empty.

prefix.description: First characters of the secret, for identification.

secret.description: Only present at creation/rotation. Shown once.

200.description: Logged in; session cookie set. With 2FA enabled (or required), returns a login challenge for the second step instead.
Always 200; authenticated flag tells the truth.

post.summary: Complete two-step login with a TOTP or recovery code

200.description: Enabled/required flags and unused recovery code count.

post.summary: Start 2FA setup; returns provisioning URI, QR image and secret

challenge.description: Login challenge; authorizes first-time enrollment during login

post.summary: Verify setup code; enables 2FA and returns recovery codes (once)
Replace own recovery codes (password proof required)
Reset a user's 2FA - lockout recovery (admin session only)

mutedUntil.description: RFC3339 expiry for status muted; empty mutes forever.

resolveInRelease.description: With status resolved: pin to the issue's current release and reopen only on a different release.

delete.summary: Delete issue note (scoped to the issue)

get.summary: Project overview bento (counters, severity volume, top issues)
Per-release rollup (events, issues, sessions, crash-free rates)

post.summary: Ingest a synthetic test event through the real pipeline
Upload source map (upsert per release + bundle URL)

put.summary: Save channel webhook (slack, discord, teams, sheets)

secret.description: HMAC-SHA256 signing secret; blank means unsigned.

put.summary: Update generic webhook (blank secret keeps the stored one)

password.description: Blank or masked keeps the stored secret.

post.summary: Create API key (admin session only; secret shown once)
Rotate API key (admin session only; old secret dies)

200.description: Replacement key with new one-time secret.

get.summary: Crawler deny-all (the app is private internal tooling)
Liveness check (process is up; does not touch the database)
Public build metadata (version, go version, db driver, uptime)
Prometheus metrics (only when SPLAT_METRICS is enabled)

delete.summary: Delete user (admin session only; never the last user or self)

put.summary: Set instance role (admin session only; never demote the last admin)

get.summary: List teams with members and projects (admin session only)

delete.summary: Delete team (admin session only; grants cascade)

post.summary: Grant project to team (admin session only)

delete.summary: Revoke project from team (admin session only)

200.description: Direct member ids and granted teams.

post.summary: Grant user directly to project (admin session only)

delete.summary: Remove direct project grant (admin session only)

get.summary: Trace detail: transactions, spans and logs (project access required)

200.description: Repo config with masked token, or null.

put.summary: Link repository (admin session only; token blank keeps stored secret)

delete.summary: Unlink repository (admin session only; links are kept)

get.summary: External issues of a Splat issue

post.summary: File this issue on the linked forge

delete.summary: Unlink an external issue (the forge issue itself is untouched)

get.summary: Release detail: rollup, environment breakdown, issues new in release

parameters.name: release
parameters.description: URL-encoded release name; (none) for empty release

get.summary: List audit log entries, newest first (admin session only)

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Action prefix filter, e.g. auth. or users.

get.summary: Quota limits and current usage for a project

put.summary: Set per-project quota overrides (admin session only)

Start SSO login (redirects to the provider)
